rationale: The challenge notes that Figure 5.3 is a typical schematic and that deep-learning behavior depends on data, optimization, and regularization. This does not defeat the claim, because the claim is strictly scoped as a factual report of how the Goodfellow et al. textbook illustrates model capacity, underfitting, and overfitting. Source S-020 (Chapter 5, Section 5.2, Figure 5.3 caption and text, pp. 112–113) explicitly defines the underfitting regime as high training and generalization error and the overfitting regime as an expanding generalization gap when capacity exceeds optimal capacity.
evidence_locators: Official HTML Chapter 5, Section 5.2 Capacity, Overfitting and Underfitting, Figure 5.3 (book printed pp. 112–113)
limitations: Textbook conceptual schematics do not capture modern empirical phenomena such as benign overfitting or double descent, nor do they establish safety guarantees for vision systems.
